objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "Alternatively, you can open any Wikipedia page and choose Book Creator from the toolbox menu in the right sidebar."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Book Creator'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: toolbox menu needed to reveal the named item; role=button; text="Tools" | HINTS: container=Page tools in the right sidebar
actions.instr: Clicking Tools in the right sidebar toolbox menu
